business_summary: Watahan & Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the retail, construction, and trading businesses in Japan. The Retail segment offers streamlining of business and transportation operations and inventory management; furniture, interior goods, apparel, and general merchandise, CG business, etc.; assembled furniture manufacturing, wholesale, and internet mail order business; manufacturing, wholesale and sales of tea leaves and sweets, and selling snacks in the café space; building renovation work, self-driving multi-storey car parks, steel frame construction and other construction work; sales of detached wooden houses, design and construction, franchise management, construction of detached houses, import of lumber and building materials, manufacturing and sales of pre-cut materials and building materials; and detached houses, sales of building materials, etc., and technical and sales support for franchisees. The Construction Business segment offers sales and construction of custom-built homes; and manufacturing and sales of wood biomass chips, housing materials sales businesses, and wood processing products. The trading business segment provides import and sale of pharmaceutical raw materials, and chemical raw materials. The company also offers industrial-use wax, and general and health food materials; franchise business for wooden detached houses; sales of materials and sales promotion materials; technical and sales support for franchisees; grocery store management, drugstores, and online retailers. In addition, the company offers technical advisory services for construction and steel frame processing work; maintenance services for buildings; home care services for seniors and individuals with disabilities; and elderly welfare services. Watahan & Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1598 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Watahan & Co.,Ltd.는 자회사를 통해 일본에서 소매, 건설, 무역 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 소매 부문은 비즈니스 및 운송 운영과 재고 관리의 간소화를 제공합니다. 가구, 인테리어 잡화, 의류, 잡화, CG사업 등 조립가구 제조, 도매, 인터넷 통신판매업; 찻잎 및 과자 제조, 도매 및 판매, 카페 공간에서의 스낵 판매; 건물 개조 공사, 자율주행 다층 주차장, 철골 공사 및 기타 건설 공사; 단독 목조 주택 판매, 설계 및 시공, 프랜차이즈 관리, 단독 주택 건설, 목재 및 건축 자재 수입, 사전 절단 자재 및 건축 자재 제조 및 판매; 단독주택, 건축자재 판매 등, 가맹점 기술 및 영업 지원 등을 담당하고 있습니다. 건설 사업 부문은 맞춤형 주택 판매 및 건설을 제공합니다. 목재바이오매스칩, 주택자재 판매업, 목재가공제품의 제조 및 판매업을 영위하고 있습니다. 무역 사업 부문은 의약품의 수입 및 판매를 제공합니다.
